decisions.reason: The yogurt on mango mousse won the eathealthy Award, which signals results above aspiration, and it sits close to the core yogurt business, so there is no trigger for search.
The Abendbrotkäse was featured prominently on the home page as a new launch, a sign of management commitment, and it is too early for a shortfall to have appeared in a growing organic market.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established offer and is cheap to carry within existing production, so its uncertain results do not yet justify dropping it.
The spicy cheese was only mentioned, with no reported success, so it is more exposed to problemistic search, but one year is short and industry growth provides some slack.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the Monsieur Jean Bernard line, which supports keeping it while results are still uncertain.
The washed-rind soft cheese is more niche and has no evidence of results, which raises the risk of a shortfall, but the firm likely has enough slack in a growing market to keep it another year.
